notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Beast.
description:
Activate Ravenous Baloth by sacrificing another Beast, causing you to gain 4 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Fungus and/or Beast you control.
Repeat.
If you control at least two additional Beasts and/or one additional Fungus to begin the combo, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.
